candidates.reason: Banner structure (can left, headline centre, CTA under it) is sensible, but the legal line sits top-left as the first thing you read, above the bullets. The bullets are out of order: 'Wild honey' is on the left while 'Garden herbs', 'Pressed blood orange' and 'Fine bubbles' are on the right. Bullet and legal text are too small to read at this size, and the can is shrunk to a sliver without its circle.

This is the portrait original shrunk into the centre of the banner with huge empty side margins. The headline, bullets, CTA and tagline are microscopic and unreadable, and nothing has been rearranged for the wide format.

Practically identical to candidate 1 and has the same flaws. The legal line sits top-left and leads the reading order, the bullets are split across the two sides out of their original order, the bullet and legal text are too small to read, and the can is cramped at the far-left edge.

The hierarchy is broken. The headline is wrapped onto 3 cramped lines in the left corner, the legal text is set as a tall paragraph next to it, and the 'Fine bubbles' bullet is blown up to rival the headline. The CTA is shrunk into the top-right corner and collides with the bullets, and the tagline is jammed along the bottom edge. The layout looks scattered.
